Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

VLDB 2021 Crowd Science Challenge on Aggregating Crowdsourced Audio Transcriptions · paper method: ROVER aligns submitted word sequences and votes at each token, allowing an output different from every worker submission; RASA and HRRASA instead choose one submitted transcription.

candidate.next8.vldb2021.paper.aggregation-baselines.v2

  • The report gives private-test AWAcc of 92.25% for ROVER and 91.04% for each of RASA and HRRASA.
  • HRRASA additionally uses local reliability represented by GLEU distance to other responses for the recording.

VLDB 2021 Crowd Science Challenge on Aggregating Crowdsourced Audio Transcriptions · paper method: The shared-task dataset was constructed from normalized English Wikipedia and BookCorpus sentences, synthesized as audio with Yandex SpeechKit and transcribed on Toloka by at least five different workers per recording.

VLDB 2021 Crowd Science Challenge on Aggregating Crowdsourced Audio Transcriptions · dataset size: Table 1 lists 9,700 training recordings with 67,900 transcriptions and 4,502 test recordings with 31,514 transcriptions; the test set is split into 1,500 public and 3,002 private recordings.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

VLDB 2021 Crowd Science Challenge on Aggregating Crowdsourced Audio Transcriptions · evaluates: The competition scores mean per-recording word accuracy, AWAcc = mean(max(0, 1−WER(r))) × 100%, using JiWER for each recording; live competition scores use the public test subset and final standings use the private subset.

candidate.next8.vldb2021.paper.evaluation-design.v3

  • The practice phase provides training ground truth, while the evaluation phase hides test ground truth.
  • The score averages clipped per-recording accuracies rather than applying one corpus-level word-error rate.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

VLDB 2021 Crowd Science Challenge on Aggregating Crowdsourced Audio Transcriptions · paper method: The winning system fine-tuned a BART summarization model on the shared-task data, shuffled input transcriptions for augmentation and normalized British word forms to American forms; it achieved reported private-test AWAcc of 95.73%.

candidate.next8.vldb2021.paper.winning-method.v3

  • The comparison is within this 2021 shared task: Table 2 gives private-test ROVER AWAcc of 92.25%, and the public/private scores use distinct subsets.
